explanations.title: Instruction override
explanations.why_it_matters: Instructions embedded in tool content may conflict with the user's intent or the agent's governing instructions.
explanations.remediation: Remove instruction-like text from tool descriptions and isolate untrusted content from trusted instructions.

explanations.title: Instruction override
explanations.why_it_matters: Instructions embedded in tool content may conflict with the user's intent or the agent's governing instructions.
explanations.remediation: Remove instruction-like text from tool descriptions and isolate untrusted content from trusted instructions.

explanations.title: Hidden Unicode in descriptions
explanations.why_it_matters: Invisible or direction-changing characters can disguise text from reviewers while remaining present to downstream consumers.
explanations.remediation: Reject unexpected control and format characters, and render descriptions in a way that exposes invisible characters during review.

explanations.title: Exfiltration through attacker-controlled URLs
explanations.why_it_matters: Sending sensitive values to a caller-controlled destination can disclose data outside the intended trust boundary.
explanations.remediation: Use allowlisted destinations, avoid placing sensitive values in URLs, and validate both scheme and host.

explanations.title: Secrets embedded in descriptions
explanations.why_it_matters: Tool descriptions may be exposed to clients, logs, or model context and are not a safe place for credentials.
explanations.remediation: Remove credentials from descriptions, rotate exposed secrets, and retrieve secrets through a protected mechanism.

explanations.title: Hidden AI-directed content
explanations.why_it_matters: Instructions hidden in markup or metadata may be overlooked in ordinary review but still reach an agent.
explanations.remediation: Strip or expose hidden markup, inspect normalized content, and keep machine-consumed metadata reviewable.
